summary: English and French first-party discovery identified Guinea's official cadastre.mines.gov.gn ArcGIS host and the official Kindia prefecture portal. The application layer is token-gated; the only anonymous map service exposed country boundaries, not parcels. No parcel ID or polygon was retained.
